q1_issues.issue: "Jackson's visit" is a possessor marked by 's, and the genitive rule's single test (is the possessed a part/component? no) yields (Possession sk_visit_1 jackson); the parse instead assigns the thematic role (Agent sk_visit_1 jackson), which no rule licenses for a possessive.

q2_gaps: a measured distance between two entities ("about 100 miles northeast of Chicago") — Measure is one-place, so the magnitude lands on Benton Harbor alone and the relatum Chicago is severed from it; MoreBy is the only two-place measured relation and it is a comparative, not a separation

the possessive subject of an event nominalization ("Jackson's visit" = Jackson visits) — the Complements section covers only a nominalization's of-phrase OBJECT, and nothing says whether the 's possessor may fill a thematic role on the event-noun witness
notes: The rest follows the instruction set: NortheastOf is the licensed entity-attached multi-word surface preposition, "about 100 miles" takes the tight-hedge distribution (ParticleFromNormal 100 10), "relatively peaceful" keeps the positive property plus a surface-adverb Degree on the entity, and the transitive follow keeps Agent (inanimate subject) / Theme (unchanged object).
